# opentls.library API headers

The public headers of opentls.library, API version 1 (frozen 9 October
2026), from DalsinAI/openamigatls main (commit e7c0e2d, 19 October 2026:
`OT_GetPeerName` at the end of the table, and the VBCC inline calls),
unchanged. MIT licensed and free, Copyright (c) 2026 AmigaChrome Team
(`LICENSE`). The contract is that repository's `docs/AutoDocs-OpenTLS.md`;
later versions only add, so these keep working. OpenMail's network layer
(`platform/amiga/oam_net_amiga.c`) is built against them; the library
itself is opened at run time, never linked.
